name: A-One Signature - Century Square
description:
Embark on a gastronomic journey of authentic claypot wonders that satisfy both palates and soul.
A-One Signature offers a wide variety of dishes to suit every diner in a feel-at-home, comfortable modern Chinese interior. With sizzling hot, fragrant local favourites served on piping hot claypots and hotplates, we promise an all-round dining satisfaction that is set to entice and excite every of your senses.
